response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems experience, with exposure to event-driven architectures and AI-agent tooling. However, his background lacks explicit executive leadership in fintech or regulated environments, and his agentic AI experience appears limited to tooling rather than core architecture or production deployment at scale.
strengths: Proven track record in full-stack development and distributed systems, including high-throughput microservices and real-time data processing.
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators) and open-source contributions to event-driven platforms.
Diverse technical expertise across languages (TypeScript, Dlang, JavaScript) and domains (GIS, fintech-adjacent, embedded systems).
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience; current roles are individual contributor or staff-level, not CTO-scale.
Agentic AI experience appears peripheral (tooling/frameworks) rather than core architecture or production deployment in regulated environments.
Limited evidence of fintech infrastructure expertise (e.g., credit systems, compliance, or multi-jurisdictional regulatory frameworks).
